body:
Source-only `mori inspect` discarded errors from the profile-header reader and fell through to the Core/1 parser, losing the existing dual-profile diagnostic. Propagate that error through the existing CLI renderer before selecting the source profile.

Validation: the new aggregate regression fails against the parent and passes with the repair for unknown, missing and commented UTF-8 headers. All three child outputs are captured before assertions. Two existing positive tests pass for valid Core/1 and Core/2 source consumers. The recorded candidate differs from the author test only by rustfmt argument-array wrapping; frozen diagnostic literals are unchanged. All 903 recorded after-source pins match the committed tree. Formatting was checked with edition 2024.

This draft is stacked on #248. Independent source/result review is pending. Target/native paths were unchanged and unrun; these ordinary diagnostics and positive controls establish no proof, ledger, financial or full-language acceptance.
title: Preserve Core header errors in source inspection
